options.content:
**GenLayer Validator Status board — public view.** Testnet **Bradbury Phase 2** (Asimov and Bradbury Phase 1 were sunset in 2026-10). Three summary rows reconcile who *should* be validating against what is *actually* observable, then the table drills down per validator. Read-only; data is queried live on each load.

**Validators** — the roster & on-chain picture. *Total* = every known node (portal roster ∪ reporting ∪ on-chain active). The roster is deduped in the query itself: operators who re-registered keep only their live wallet(s); superseded inactive wallets are dropped, and a fully-inactive operator keeps one row. *Internal* = Foundation/Labs nodes (name contains 'GenLayer'). *On-chain active* = live Staking.selectableValidators() set (strict consensus-duty eligibility; excludes quarantined; empty until the first epoch advance). *Quarantined* = live on-chain Staking.getAllQuarantinedValidators() (NOT the portal). *Portal: active / Inactive / Banned* = portal roster status counts (Inactive is deduped the same way). *Missing* = graduated portal validators (past the waitlist) with no wallet linked on this network — either not running here at all, or running an unlinked wallet the portal can't attribute. Note: on-chain active often differs from portal active because the portal syncs periodically.

**Metrics** — *Reporting (metrics)* = nodes emitting Prometheus in the last 5 min. *Not reporting (metrics)* = on-chain active but silent on metrics.

**Logs** — *Reporting (logs)* = nodes shipping logs to Loki in the last 5 min. *Not reporting (logs)* = on-chain active but silent on logs.

**Table columns** — *Name* one merged display name, in priority order portal account name (tagged '(portal)') > on-chain identity moniker > metrics validator_name > node address · *Identity* OK / missing: … (on-chain getIdentity() moniker/logo/description completeness) · *Linked* linked / NOT LINKED (whether the wallet is attributed to a portal account) · *In Portal* Yes/No (has a roster row on this network) · *Participating* active / quarantined / MISSING (graduated but no wallet on this network) / not participating (live, on-chain) · *Metrics/Logs* ON/OFF/- · *Node Version* as reported by the node's metrics · *Blocks Behind* from metrics. Rows sorted worst-first.

panels.description: All validators known for bradbury-phase2: union of the portal roster, nodes reporting to Grafana, and the live on-chain active set (distinct node addresses). Superseded wallets (inactive, with a live sibling wallet under the same account/name) are dropped in the roster query itself.

targets.root_selector:
[ .[] ]
| group_by(if (.account // "") != "" then "a:" + .account elif (.name // "") != "" then "n:" + .name else "x:" + .node end)
| map( ([ .[] | select(.status != "inactive") ]) as $live | if ($live | length) > 0 then $live else [ .[-1] ] end )
| (add // [])
| map(. + {rone: 1})

.result | ltrimstr("0x") | .[128:]
| [ range(0; (length/64)) as $i | .[$i*64:($i+1)*64] ]
| map(select(length==64) | {node: ("0x" + (.[24:64] | ascii_downcase)), onchain_active: 1})
| map(select(.node != "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"))

targets.root_selector:
[{ "c": ( def hexval: ascii_downcase | ltrimstr("0") | explode | reduce .[] as $c (0; . * 16 + (if $c >= 48 and $c <= 57 then $c - 48 else $c - 87 end)); (map(select(.id==1)) | .[0].result | ltrimstr("0x") | hexval) as $cur
| (map(select(.id==2)) | .[0].result | ltrimstr("0x") | .[128:]) as $h | [ range(0; ($h|length)/192) as $i | {node: ("0x" + ($h[$i*192+24:$i*192+64] | ascii_downcase)), until_epoch: ($h[$i*192+64:$i*192+128] | hexval), perm: (($h[$i*192+128:$i*192+192] | hexval) > 0)} ] | map(select(.node != "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000")) | map(select(.perm or (.until_epoch > $cur))) | length ) }]

panels.description: Live on-chain active set (Staking.selectableValidators()) reconciled against the portal roster and Grafana, joined by node address. Lists ALL portal validators for bradbury-phase2 (active + inactive + quarantined), any node reporting/active but not in the portal, and graduated validators with no wallet on this network (MISSING). Roster is deduped at the datasource: inactive wallets superseded by a live wallet under the same account/name are dropped; a fully-inactive operator keeps one row. Name: single merged display name, in priority order portal account name (tagged '(portal)') > on-chain identity moniker > metrics validator_name > node address. Identity: on-chain getIdentity() completeness (OK / missing: moniker/logo/description), computed here from the roster's raw fields. Linked: whether the wallet is attributed to a portal account (linked / NOT LINKED). In Portal: Yes/No (has a roster row on this network). Participating (live on-chain): active / quarantined / MISSING (graduated but no wallet here) / not participating. Metrics/Logs: ON = reporting last 5m, OFF = on-chain active but not reporting, - = not applicable. Version: OK/behind vs the latest version seen in the wild. Blocks Behind from metrics. Rows sorted worst-first.

targets.root_selector:
[ .[] ]
| group_by(if (.account // "") != "" then "a:" + .account elif (.name // "") != "" then "n:" + .name else "x:" + .node end)
| map( ([ .[] | select(.status != "inactive") ]) as $live | if ($live | length) > 0 then $live else [ .[-1] ] end )
| (add // [])
| map(. + {rone: 1, misone: (if .status == "missing" then 1 else 0 end), linked_txt: (if .linked == null then "-" elif .linked then "linked" else "NOT LINKED" end), pref_name: (if (.account_name // "") != "" then (.account_name + " (portal)") elif (.moniker // "") != "" then .moniker else null end), identity: (if (.moniker == null and .logo_uri == null and .has_description == null) then "-" else ([ (if (.moniker // "") == "" then "moniker" else empty end), (if (.logo_uri // "") == "" then "logo" else empty end), (if .has_description == true then empty else "description" end) ] | if length == 0 then "OK" else ("missing: " + join(", ")) end) end)} | del(.linked, .moniker, .logo_uri, .has_description))

.result | ltrimstr("0x") | .[128:]
| [ range(0; (length/64)) as $i | .[$i*64:($i+1)*64] ]
| map(select(length==64) | {node: ("0x" + (.[24:64] | ascii_downcase)), onchain_active: 1})
| map(select(.node != "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"))

def hexval: ascii_downcase | ltrimstr("0") | explode | reduce .[] as $c (0; . * 16 + (if $c >= 48 and $c <= 57 then $c - 48 else $c - 87 end));
(map(select(.id==1)) | .[0].result | ltrimstr("0x") | hexval) as $cur
| (map(select(.id==2)) | .[0].result | ltrimstr("0x") | .[128:]) as $h
| [ range(0; ($h|length)/192) as $i | {node: ("0x" + ($h[$i*192+24:$i*192+64] | ascii_downcase)), until_epoch: ($h[$i*192+64:$i*192+128] | hexval), perm: (($h[$i*192+128:$i*192+192] | hexval) > 0)} ]
| map(select(.node != "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"))
| map(select(.perm or (.until_epoch > $cur)))
| map({node: .node, onchain_quarantined: 1})
